intro:
PYT offers local schools on-site, after-school drama classes and productions, called School Play in a Box (SPIB).

With SPIB, students learn acting skills, character development, team-building, storytelling, creativity, leadership skills, and more! It's also a great way for students to make new friends and build confidence.

Our instructors are experienced theater professionals, and meet with your students (up to 20 per class) once a week for 90 minutes at a time. During meetings, we play theatre games, practice skills, and rehearse a script for a final performance.

The class culminates after 10 weeks with a performance for family and friends.
current_sessions_intro: Please note that if your school has one of our programs and it is not listed on the registration page, it is because your school is handling registration through the school office.
inquiry_intro: For more information, or to inquire how to bring School Play in a Box to your school, contact our Education Program Manager, Caitlyn DeRouin.
